question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"audience". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Audience" is the appropriate word given the context of public speaking, which is the subject of the passage.(श्रोता)
 
• When someone is giving a speech or a presentation, they're addressing an audience.

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 1". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Adult"** doesn't fit the context of public speaking.(वयस्क)

 
 
• We use this term when we talk about individuals who are fully grown or mature, irrespective of them being part of a public speaking context or not.
 
 
 
• **"Accomplice" **refers to a person who helps another commit a crime and doesn't fit the context of the sentence.(साथी)
 
• **"Association" **generally refers to a connection, relation, or involvement between two or more parties.(संगठन)
 
 
• It can also refer to an organized body of individuals who have an interest, activity, or purpose in common.
 
• Although you might have an association with an audience, in this context, it's more accurate to say you're addressing the audience directly.
